claim.value: Isolated improvement would warrant continued observation.
claim.scope: Conditional response to an isolated improvement; no isolated improvement is reported.

provenance.rationale: The span directly attributes continued observation to isolated improvement.

signal_basis.value: Monitoring the same turnaround measurements through a predefined trial period shows an isolated improvement rather than improvement sustained across repeated periods.
signal_basis.scope: Post-selection trial monitoring. Apparent improvement can reflect measurement or operational variation; continued observation does not authorize continuing an unsafe or unacceptably disruptive trial.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans supply the monitoring operation, isolated-improvement signal, sources of apparent variation, and limits on trial continuation.
The verdict is SUPPORTED; no unresolved empirical relation is required for this component.

rationale: An isolated improvement leaves its persistence unresolved. Continuing comparable observations is warranted to assess whether improvement persists or reverses. This modest claim requires neither causal identification nor proof that the change should be retained.
uncertainty: Whether improvement will persist or result from the trial remains unknown; that uncertainty supports further observation within the stated limits.
